theme_strategy: Editorial Dark Mode (Primary) with subtle earthy/parchment light mode for long-form reading elements, creating a museum-like, deeply devotional and cinematic atmosphere.

headings.usage_rules: Use for all H1, H2, H3. Embrace italic variants for emphasis, Sanskrit terms, or poetic quotes (like Gita Govinda lines). Never bold excessively; prefer font-light or font-medium for a premium editorial look. Extremely tight or slightly loose tracking based on context (tight for massive hero, loose for chapter headers).

body.usage_rules: Clean, highly legible geometric/humanist sans for long-form reading (Nityanushtanam mantras, history paragraphs). text-base with leading-relaxed (1.625+ line height).

accents.usage_rules: Use uppercase Outfit with wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]) for overlines, labels, chapter numbers, and metadata.

colors.usage_rules: The site is predominantly dark (stone-950) to create a cinematic, temple-like sanctity. Use Vermilion (#9F1239) for micro-interactions or spiritual high-impact moments. Use Aged Gold (#D4AF37) for divine text, active states, and chapter numerals. Never use full-screen gradients; use a radial glow (e.g., glowing gold or red from top corners at 10% opacity) to mimic temple lighting.

visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle SVG noise overlay (mix-blend-overlay, 2-4% opacity) on the main background to remove digital flatness and mimic ancient stone/parchment.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-stone-800 for delineating bento grids, chapter sections, and admin cards.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal use of shadows in dark mode. Instead, use border highlights and subtle inner glows.
visual_enhancers.images: Hero images must have a vignette or black gradient overlay (e.g., bg-gradient-to-t from-stone-950 to-transparent) to ensure text contrast. Use cinematic clipping (e.g., arched masks or sharp rectangular crops with generous padding).

component_strategy.marketing_pages: Custom HTML/Tailwind. Raw div structures for overlapping grids and staggered layouts. Avoid Shadcn for main public-facing experiential sections.
component_strategy.admin_panel: Strict Shadcn UI. Use DataTable, Dialog, Form, Input, Button, Card, Tabs. Functional, high-density, accessible.
component_strategy.forms_and_interactive: Shadcn components deeply customized to match the brand (gold/vermilion focus rings, dark stone backgrounds).
component_strategy.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Slow speed (20-30). Pale gold or dark stone-800 text (depending on contrast). Used for Sanskrit shlokas or 'Jai Jagannath'.

grids.manifesto_chapters: Staggered 'Tetris' bento grid. Wide gaps (gap-8 md:gap-16). Large numbers spanning multiple rows.
grids.gallery: Masonry or staggered bento grid. Direct children of grid must be framer-motion motion.divs for scroll stagger.
grids.admin_dashboard: High-density CSS Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4), tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Cards have h-full.

layouts.hero: 100vh height. Background image with slow scale (Ken Burns). Central or left-aligned massive heading with masked line-by-line reveal. Scroll indicator at bottom.
layouts.deep_pages: Max-width containers (max-w-4xl) for readability on text-heavy pages (Biographies, Nityanushtanam). Include a sticky table of contents on the side for desktop.
layouts.navigation: Crystal glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-stone-950/70) sticky header. Bottom border border-stone-800. Must not be fully transparent.

motion.hero_reveal: Framer Motion: Initial { y: '100%', opacity: 0 }, Animate { y: 0, opacity: 1 }, transition { staggerChildren: 0.1, duration: 0.8, ease: [0.33, 1, 0.68, 1] }. Text lines MUST be wrapped in overflow-hidden divs.
motion.scroll_reveal: Framer Motion whileInView for fading up sections as they enter viewport.
motion.smooth_scroll: MANDATORY: @studio-freight/lenis. Initialize in a higher-order component or layout wrapper for buttery smooth momentum scrolling.
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on gallery items: image scale 1.05, filter grayscale to color, or subtle dimming of siblings.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially gold on dark, meets WCAG AA (at least 4.5:1 for body).
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query in framer-motion configs.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements, buttons, nav links, and form inputs MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='nav-gallery-link', data-testid='admin-upload-btn').

media.usage: Do not use placeholders. Use these URLs specifically where thematic fit is needed. For the Rath Yatra gallery, map the ratha_yatra images. For the Gita Govinda section, use classical_art. For Nityanushtanam, use rituals_aarti.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-end, Awwwards-level devotional and cultural editorial platform.
Implement @studio-freight/lenis in a global wrapper component for smooth momentum scrolling.
Use framer-motion heavily for the Hero section: wrap each text line of the main heading in a div with overflow-hidden, and animate the child text element up from y: 100%.
Install and use react-fast-marquee for the slow editorial scrolling text (Shlokas).
For typography, import 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Outfit' from Google Fonts in index.css.
Build the Admin panel using Shadcn UI in a strictly functional layout. Route should be /admin.
Do NOT center-align body text on editorial pages. Keep it left-aligned for readability, limited to max-w-3xl.
Avoid the generic 'SaaS' look. No floating white cards with generic shadows on the public site.
All navigation, forms, and interactive buttons must contain data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Apply to specific properties like opacity, transform.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations & context-relevant color.
NEVER use emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use lucide-react or phosphor icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Add subtle grain textures, noise overlays, and loading animations.
NEVER use placeholder image URLs. Use the provided curated image links.
